title: Meros Event Envelope v1
description: The product-agnostic event contract every Meros product emits to a collector (Imperio, the Meros cloud, both, or neither). One event is one flat JSON object; the local log is newline-delimited JSON. Generalized from the Sluice-derived draft into a portfolio contract: `seq` and `subject` are optional so trivial emitters aren't burdened, `critical` severity is available. See docs/event-envelope.md. This schema is the conformance authority; size limits (attrs <= 16 KiB, total <= 64 KiB) are enforced by the collector, not expressible here. Collector receipt metadata (received_at, clock_suspect) is tracked outside the envelope, never injected into it.

envelope.description: Envelope format version. Frozen at 1. Additive fields never bump it; only a breaking change does.

id.description: ULID, emitter-generated, 26 chars Crockford base32. Sortable by time and the idempotency key: a collector dedupes on (source.instance, id).

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, millisecond precision, emitter clock. When it happened, not when it was sent. Must end in 'Z'.

seq.description: Optional monotonic sequence per (source.product, source.instance), from 1, persisted across restarts. Lets a collector detect gaps (events lost vs never emitted). Omitted by emitters that cannot persist a counter.

product.description: Lowercase product slug; the namespace owner for `type` (manifold, basin, sluice, rfdeck, drawlive, imperio, ...). Unknown slugs accepted.

version.description: Emitter software version — correlates behaviour with a release.

instance.description: Stable opaque per-install id, generated locally on first run. Never a MAC address. Unique within a product; part of the dedupe key.

site.description: Optional operator-assigned local site label. NOT the cloud's tenancy — the cloud assigns a site server-side from the ingest token.

edition.description: Optional build tier — tells you which tier generated a fault.

type.description: `product.subject.verb`, lowercase, dot-separated, past tense (a thing that happened). The product owns its namespace; unknown type VALUES are accepted, only the shape is fixed.

severity.description: Syslog-style level; drives alert routing without parsing attrs.

subject.description: Optional — what the event is about. A stable kind+id, with an optional display name.

actor.description: Optional — who/what caused it. Absent means unknown, which is different from `system`. `external` means another controller did it.

attrs.description: Product-specific, opaque to every other product (event contract, not state contract). Serialized <= 16 KiB (collector-enforced).

trace.description: Optional correlation id tying a caused chain of events together.
